name: happy-health
description: Happy Health — on-demand home care (home nursing, doctor home visits, medical equipment rental) in Pakistan.

scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && rm -rf /tmp/gh-pages-dist && git worktree prune && git branch -f gh-pages HEAD && git worktree add /tmp/gh-pages-dist gh-pages && find /tmp/gh-pages-dist -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .git -exec rm -rf {} + && cp -a dist/. /tmp/gh-pages-dist/ && git -C /tmp/gh-pages-dist add -A && git -C /tmp/gh-pages-dist commit -q -m "deploy: pages build $(date +%F-%H%M%S)" && git push origin gh-pages --force && git worktree remove /tmp/gh-pages-dist --force && git worktree prune
